svg.title: Beach: swash, backwash, longshore drift, berms and storm beach
svg.desc: A plan view of waves driven by the prevailing wind reaching the shore at an angle, so the swash carries material up the beach at that angle and the backwash drags it straight back down, moving it along the coast in a zig-zag (longshore drift); a cross-section shows a beach built by constructive waves, with berms at the high tide marks and a storm beach of large stones at the back.
